 Print this Article 
 View Comments Paul George has averaged 21.3 points per game this season for the Celtics. Barry Chin/Globe Staff The Celtics have put the puzzle pieces together when a full roster is out of the question. They’d like to field a complete group in Friday’s NBA Cup group play matchup in Charlotte. 
 Paul George supplied 25 points and Derrick White added 24 in the Celtics’ 109-102 win against the Bucks Wednesday night . Jayson Tatum (rest) missed a game for the first time this season. 
 “Obviously it changes a little bit because JT does a lot for us,” White said. “But at the end of the day, we believe in our depth, we believe in every person in the locker room, and we just got to go out there and get a win.” 
 George had his largest point total since the season opener, a 121-113 loss to the Pistons in Detroit . 
 “We need the best version of him for us to be a great team, and I think you were able to see that [Wednesday],” Celtics coach Joe Mazzulla said.

 “We want JT to get his rest in those situations, so we got to come together and collectively be big in those moments,” George said. 
 Related : When Jayson Tatum sits, Paul George — healthy and rested — shifts into ‘attack mode’ Here’s a preview of Friday night’s action. 
 When: Friday, 7 p.m. 
 Where: Spectrum Center, Charlotte, N.C. 
 TV: NBCSB. Radio: WBZ-FM 98.5. 
 Line: Boston -8.5. O/U: 208.5. 
 CELTICS 
 Season record: 6-2. vs. spread: 3-4, 1 push. Over/under: 3-4, 1 push 
 Last 10 games: 6-4. vs. spread: 3-6, 1 push. Over/under: 4-5, 1 push 
 HORNETS 
 Season record: 3-6. vs. spread: 3-6. Over/under: 3-6 
 Last 10 games: 3-7. vs. spread: 3-7. Over/under: 3-7 
 TEAM STATISTICS 
 Points per game: Boston 114.3, Charlotte 98.1 
 Points allowed per game: Boston 108.3, Charlotte 109.2 
 Field goal percentage: Boston .451, Charlotte .404 
 Opponent field goal percentage: Boston .439, Charlotte .474 
 3-point percentage: Boston .353, Charlotte .296 
 Opponent 3-point percentage: Boston .354, Charlotte .389 
 Stat of the day: The Celtics are 20-4 vs. the Hornets in the last 24 regular-season matchups. 
 Notes: Charlotte has lost five games in a row. ... Hornets guard Kon Knueppel exited six minutes into his season debut due to left leg soreness in Wednesday’s 114-104 loss to the Nets. ... Knueppel injured his left hamstring during the offseason and missed all of the preseason, in addition to the first eight games of the regular season. His availability is in question for Friday night’s contest. ... Boston is 1-2 in road games.
